wrongAnswers.expectedFact: You're exempt from paying the open work permit holder fee (CAN$100)
wrongAnswers.answer: Yes. You’re exempt from paying the open work permit holder fee (CAN$100).

wrongAnswers.question: My employer got a positive LMIA through the Global Talent Stream. Could my work permit be processed in 2 weeks?
wrongAnswers.expectedFact: 2-week processing ... through the Global Talent Stream
wrongAnswers.answer: No. The processing time for a work permit is not guaranteed to be two weeks. The processing time depends on the complexity of the application and the volume of applications being processed.
